decisions.reason: Precisely locates inject/apiProxy.llm.providers and the dead never-imported apiproxy dependency, and explains the break mechanism, but the change-card catalog was unavailable so it maps only to card subjects, never to A1-01.
All other categories covered with file:line evidence; session-notes decoy correctly identified as pure utilities; cordis.patch.yml treated as a composition/manifest record, not a host-source patch.

Section 3 argues zero hits establish scope, not compatibility; scan coverage, dependency pins and silent runtime failure need separate evidence, and the hit apiProxy break is distinguished from the negative categories.
Proposes (not executes) install/resolution check, isolated cold boot on the target, a smoke asserting the resolved provider list, plus stderr and shutdown checks.
